queries.query: Europe PMC REST search: "DNA language models are powerful predictors of genome-wide variant effects" (resultType=core)
queries.outcome: Two hits: preprint PPR534879 (bioRxiv 10.1101/2022.08.22.504706, not in EPMC full text) and the published article PMID 37883436, PMC10622914, DOI 10.1073/pnas.2311219120, PNAS 2023, open access. The published version exists, so it is the primary source.

Retrieved the published article as JATS XML, 120,046 bytes, sha256 8ff2184c...; fetched twice with identical bytes. The article contains no table-wrap element: every result is in prose or in a figure.
HTTP 403. pnas.org refuses plain requests for both the article PDF and the supplement.
HTTP 200 but served a proof-of-work interstitial page, not the PDF. The PMC /bin/ path returned 404 and the europepmc.org /articles/.../bin/ path 403.

Retrieved a zip holding pnas.2311219120.sapp.pdf (6,297,039 bytes, sha256 e9ea2399...) and the figure images. The zip is built per request so its own hash differs between downloads; the PDF member was identical across two downloads.

Three preprint versions: v1 2022-08-23 and v2 2023-04-12 under earlier 'zero-shot' titles, v3 2023-08-04 under the published title; all CC BY-NC-ND, all naming 10.1073/pnas.2311219120 as the published article.
Retrieved the v3 JATS source XML named by the API, 108,500 bytes, sha256 4faeb24f...; fetched twice with identical bytes. The bioRxiv web pages themselves block plain requests.

queries.query: grep of data/entities and data/evidence for gpn, arabidopsis, aragwas, brassicales, 1001 genomes
queries.outcome: The GPN family record regulatory-variant-20261009-model-gpn exists with 17 results, all on human benchmarks (TraitGym, Tang 2025 CAGI5, EVEE). No Arabidopsis variant effect dataset, protocol or benchmark is in the store, so nothing in this paper duplicates a stored protocol.

failed_candidates.candidate: PNAS typeset article PDF and supplement from pnas.org
failed_candidates.reason: HTTP 403 to plain requests; the PMC PDF endpoint serves a proof-of-work page. The Europe PMC JATS XML was used instead, so the figure panels were never available as vector text.

failed_candidates.candidate: bioRxiv v1 and v2 full text, and the preprint's own supplementary PDF
failed_candidates.reason: Not retrieved. Only v3 was needed for the version comparison, and the preprint supplement was out of scope for a bounded pass.

decision: Extracted the published PNAS version as the primary source, with the SI Appendix for Table S2. Recorded bioRxiv v3 and the bioRxiv version list as companion sources for version history only; no result is taken from them.
gaps: Every model comparison in the paper (Figures 5D, 6D, 6E and SI Appendix Figures S6, S8 to S12) is a bar chart with no values in the text layer, so no phyloP, phastCons, abs(phyloP) or LD Score value is recorded.
The contingency tables of Figures 5C and 6C and the confusion matrix of Figure 2B are drawn as images; only the values their captions or the body text repeat are recorded.
The preprint's own SI Appendix was not retrieved, so its Table S2 was not compared with the published one.
coverage_claim: Source resolution and extraction for one paper. Not a literature pass over the GPN family or over Arabidopsis variant effect prediction.
